name: Silv GPSR Compliance for WooCommerce
author: plot

sections.description:
Ensure your WooCommerce store is 100% compliant with the EU General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR).

From December 2024, EU law mandates that online stores must display specific product safety information—including manufacturer details and safety warnings—before a customer purchases.

This plugin provides a minimal, aesthetic accordion widget on your product pages to display all required GPSR data without ruining your store’s premium design.

Key Features:

  • Effortless Input: Easily add Manufacturer Name, Contact Email/Web, Postal Address, and Safety Warnings directly from the WooCommerce product edit screen.
  • Minimalist UI/UX: A beautiful, clean accordion widget designed with a soft silver/gray aesthetic that fits perfectly into any premium brand store.
  • Zero Bloat: Lightweight code with NO external JavaScript libraries. Blazing fast loading speeds.
  • 100% Free & Open Source: Keep your store compliant without any recurring SaaS fees.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the woocommerce-gpsr-compliance folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to any Product Edit page in WooCommerce.
  4. Locate the EU silv-gpsr-compliance.php Info meta box, fill in the details, and save.
  5. The beautiful GPSR accordion will automatically display on the product page.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release. Perfect GPSR metadata storage and minimal accordion widget layout implementation.
